notes:
- Cape Studio on the Profile page: paint your own cape or import any picture, from 64x32 up to 1024x512.
- Capes can move. Add frames, set how long each one shows, or import a GIF and every frame comes along.
- See it on you before you save: a 3D player in your own skin wears the cape, and you drag to turn it round.
- Pick a start from eight templates, or open any published cape and make it your own.
- You wear a saved cape in game straight away, even while Minecraft is already running.
- SHOW IT TO EVERYONE sends it to the owner. Once published, every Iris Client player sees it on you, elytra included.
- Custom capes also show on offline mode servers, matched by player name there.
- Cape names with extremist codes, left or right, are refused. A picture only goes public after the owner has looked at it.
- Two new switches in the Right Shift menu: Custom capes and My own cape.
- Joining servers works again when the launcher has been open for a while. Your sign-in is checked right before the game starts and renewed if it ran out, instead of every server refusing you.
- If third person view ends up on a key that something else also uses, it goes back to F5. Mod Menu no longer opens together with the Iris Client menu on Right Shift.
